modifications.source_motion_status: existing project-authored candidate, not mocap or art-approved template
modifications.arm_rest_pose_method: World segment directions with native T-pose reference; gait-phase opposition and explicit forward elbow flex; never copied local rotations between rigs.

modifications.turn_correction: Heading-aware axial twist on upper arms, thighs and shins, preserving joint/foot world positions; final 15% settles to exact Idle in turned root frame. Contact drift is independently measured.
modifications.scope: Run-only front-support translation based on native thigh pitch; original topology, skin weights, textures and rest rig unchanged. Not a cloth simulation or full-body collision approval.
